playoff.note: 9th plays the Segona Divisió runner-up over two legs; the winner is in the Primera Divisió next season. 10th is relegated directly and the Segona champion comes up in its place.

conflicts.real: the league overview text describes 8 clubs, 21 rounds, a top-four/bottom-four split and 27 games
conflicts.note: That prose describes the pre-2020 eight-club format. The infobox (teams = 10) and the 2025-26 season article (ten clubs, three meetings, no split) are current and are what is recorded.

notes: Ten clubs, each pair meeting three times (27 rounds). 10th relegated to the Segona Divisió, 9th in a two-legged play-off against the Segona runner-up; the Segona champion is promoted directly, so exactly one of {9th, Segona runner-up} stays/goes up. Segona Divisió (level 2) is not in our rows, so the league is closed downwards in our data. No 2026-27 season article exists yet on English or Catalan Wikipedia and no federation page was read, so the 2026-27 shape is the 2025-26 shape. Clubs can be expelled mid-season: Pas de la Casa was removed in 2025-26 after three matchdays, which is why that season shows 24 matches per club instead of 27.
